title: A year-round tropical street view for the home window, starting with Puerto Rico
missing: Both released home rooms paint their window view into the plate: bare winter trees and brick apartment blocks. A life in Mayagüez, Puerto Rico sees a northern winter outside its window in every month. There is no window view for a tropical place, and none that changes with the season anywhere.

consumerSite.playerVisibleUse: The window of the home living room, behind everyday life at home. Both apartment plates already declare a 'living-room-window' slot of kind window-view for exactly this. Seen in a Puerto Rico life in Mayagüez.

whyNeeded: The window is in the room the player sees most. A snowless tropical city shown with leafless trees tells the player the game does not know where they live. The same view serves every coastal tropical place the game covers, so one picture fixes Puerto Rico and later the other island territories.
requestedBy: art source, client and release thread

visualContext.note: Tropical lowland with no winter leaf-off, so one picture honestly stands for all four seasons. Daylight, no storm. No named landmark and no flag. The tags describe the look asked for; there is no regional research record for Puerto Rico yet.

notes: Deliver it as the view seen through the window, cut to the 'living-room-window' slot of both apartment plates (canonical-03 and ordinary-02), rather than a full room plate. The painted view in the plate stays as the fallback.

Nothing composites a view into that slot yet, and nothing picks one by place and season. Choosing the view by the household's place and seasonOfIsoDate is a code change after the art exists, not a reason to hold this request.
The same slot then wants seasonal views for temperate places, so the existing winter view stops standing in for July. Those are separate requests by region.
First person, like every room view: nobody drawn in.
